event_summary.short: 40-year-old Shawn Madden, a veteran with PTSD, arrested in Palm Coast, FL after acting erratically, challenging police to fight, and exposing himself. He was charged with resisting, disorderly intoxication, assault on an officer, and indecent exposure, then released on $2,000 bond.
